name: Harper and Lyre
storyline:
"A New Duo, A New Adventure!"

- Welcome to Our Story: A spirited red panda and clever otter, bound together by fate and friendship. A fun and action packed platformer with a massive 18 levels! But when their peaceful festival is thrown into chaos by a malevolent spirit, Kreakli, trapped within the Pale Moonstone, they're thrust into an adventure like none before. Awakened within the gnarled heart of the Dark Oak Tree, Kreakli unleashes destruction upon their town. Now, it's up to Harper and Lyre to stop him before his shadow consumes everything. This is the nostalgic revival you've been waiting for! Join us on this adventure!
summary: Jump into Harper and Lyre's adventure! Control a red panda and otter duo through classic 3D platforming action. Jump, collect, explore colorful worlds, unlock transformations, solve puzzles, and battle enemies in this nostalgic adventure inspired by beloved N64 classics.
